objective: Repetir estrictamente la auditoria RRR GATE 1 como corrida de evidencia, sin ampliar alcance funcional, para publicar sql_readonly_evidence saneada y cerrar la certificacion del Gate 1. Auditar identidad/cliente/CRM, empresas/unidades, comercial/ventas/tickets, productos, usuarios/RBAC, campanas/comunicaciones/notificaciones, Cavas y estructuras loyalty/rewards/puntos/ledger/resenas/NPS/feedback/referidos/ranking/niveles/beneficios/segmentacion. No modificar SQL, repositorio funcional ni Produccion.
constraints: no crear ni alterar objetos SQL
no INSERT UPDATE DELETE MERGE TRUNCATE

queries.name: rrr_objects
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,o.name AS object_name,o.type_desc FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id WHERE o.is_ms_shipped=0 AND (o.name LIKE '%Cliente%' OR o.name LIKE '%CRM%' OR o.name LIKE '%Contacto%' OR o.name LIKE '%Empresa%' OR o.name LIKE '%Unidad%' OR o.name LIKE '%Comercial%' OR o.name LIKE '%Venta%' OR o.name LIKE '%Ticket%' OR o.name LIKE '%Producto%' OR o.name LIKE '%Usuario%' OR o.name LIKE '%Rol%' OR o.name LIKE '%Permiso%' OR o.name LIKE '%Notificacion%' OR o.name LIKE '%Campan%' OR o.name LIKE '%Comunic%' OR o.name LIKE '%Cava%' OR o.name LIKE '%Loyal%' OR o.name LIKE '%Reward%' OR o.name LIKE '%Punto%' OR o.name LIKE '%Saldo%' OR o.name LIKE '%Ledger%' OR o.name LIKE '%Resen%' OR o.name LIKE '%Review%' OR o.name LIKE '%NPS%' OR o.name LIKE '%Feedback%' OR o.name LIKE '%Refer%' OR o.name LIKE '%Rank%' OR o.name LIKE '%Nivel%' OR o.name LIKE '%Benef%' OR o.name LIKE '%Segment%') ORDER BY s.name,o.type_desc,o.name

queries.name: rrr_columns
queries.sql: SELECT t.name AS table_name,c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,ty.name AS data_type,c.max_length,c.is_nullable,c.is_identity FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE s.name='dbo' AND (t.name LIKE '%Cliente%' OR t.name LIKE '%CRM%' OR t.name LIKE '%Contacto%' OR t.name LIKE '%Empresa%' OR t.name LIKE '%Unidad%' OR t.name LIKE '%Comercial%' OR t.name LIKE '%Venta%' OR t.name LIKE '%Ticket%' OR t.name LIKE '%Producto%' OR t.name LIKE '%Usuario%' OR t.name LIKE '%Rol%' OR t.name LIKE '%Permiso%' OR t.name LIKE '%Notificacion%' OR t.name LIKE '%Campan%' OR t.name LIKE '%Comunic%' OR t.name LIKE '%Cava%' OR t.name LIKE '%Loyal%' OR t.name LIKE '%Reward%' OR t.name LIKE '%Punto%' OR t.name LIKE '%Saldo%' OR t.name LIKE '%Ledger%' OR t.name LIKE '%Resen%' OR t.name LIKE '%Review%' OR t.name LIKE '%NPS%' OR t.name LIKE '%Feedback%' OR t.name LIKE '%Refer%' OR t.name LIKE '%Rank%' OR t.name LIKE '%Nivel%' OR t.name LIKE '%Benef%' OR t.name LIKE '%Segment%') ORDER BY t.name,c.column_id

queries.name: rrr_keys
queries.sql: SELECT t.name AS table_name,i.name AS index_name,i.is_primary_key,i.is_unique,c.name AS column_name,ic.key_ordinal FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id JOIN sys.indexes i ON i.object_id=t.object_id JOIN sys.index_columns ic ON ic.object_id=i.object_id AND ic.index_id=i.index_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id AND c.column_id=ic.column_id WHERE s.name='dbo' AND i.is_hypothetical=0 AND (t.name LIKE '%Cliente%' OR t.name LIKE '%CRM%' OR t.name LIKE '%Contacto%' OR t.name LIKE '%Empresa%' OR t.name LIKE '%Unidad%' OR t.name LIKE '%Comercial%' OR t.name LIKE '%Venta%' OR t.name LIKE '%Ticket%' OR t.name LIKE '%Producto%' OR t.name LIKE '%Usuario%' OR t.name LIKE '%Rol%' OR t.name LIKE '%Permiso%' OR t.name LIKE '%Notificacion%' OR t.name LIKE '%Campan%' OR t.name LIKE '%Comunic%' OR t.name LIKE '%Cava%' OR t.name LIKE '%Loyal%' OR t.name LIKE '%Reward%' OR t.name LIKE '%Punto%' OR t.name LIKE '%Saldo%' OR t.name LIKE '%Ledger%' OR t.name LIKE '%Resen%' OR t.name LIKE '%Review%' OR t.name LIKE '%NPS%' OR t.name LIKE '%Feedback%' OR t.name LIKE '%Refer%' OR t.name LIKE '%Rank%' OR t.name LIKE '%Nivel%' OR t.name LIKE '%Benef%' OR t.name LIKE '%Segment%') ORDER BY t.name,i.name,ic.key_ordinal

queries.name: rrr_foreign_keys
queries.sql: SELECT OBJECT_NAME(fkc.parent_object_id) AS parent_table,pc.name AS parent_column,fk.name AS fk_name,OBJECT_NAME(fkc.referenced_object_id) AS referenced_table,rc.name AS referenced_column FROM sys.foreign_keys fk JOIN sys.foreign_key_columns fkc ON fkc.constraint_object_id=fk.object_id JOIN sys.columns pc ON pc.object_id=fkc.parent_object_id AND pc.column_id=fkc.parent_column_id JOIN sys.columns rc ON rc.object_id=fkc.referenced_object_id AND rc.column_id=fkc.referenced_column_id WHERE OBJECT_NAME(fkc.parent_object_id) LIKE '%Cliente%' OR OBJECT_NAME(fkc.parent_object_id) LIKE '%CRM%' OR OBJECT_NAME(fkc.parent_object_id) LIKE '%Cava%' OR OBJECT_NAME(fkc.parent_object_id) LIKE '%Venta%' OR OBJECT_NAME(fkc.parent_object_id) LIKE '%Ticket%' OR OBJECT_NAME(fkc.parent_object_id) LIKE '%Reward%' OR OBJECT_NAME(fkc.parent_object_id) LIKE '%Punto%' OR OBJECT_NAME(fkc.parent_object_id) LIKE '%Rank%' OR OBJECT_NAME(fkc.parent_object_id) LIKE '%Segment%' ORDER BY parent_table,fk_name,parent_column

queries.name: rrr_canonical_identity
queries.sql: SELECT t.name AS table_name, SUM(CASE WHEN c.name IN ('ClienteID','PersonaID','ContactoID','UsuarioID','EmpresaID','UnidadID','RFC','CURP','Email','Correo','Telefono','Nombre','ExternalID','SourceID') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS identity_signal_columns, COUNT(*) AS total_columns FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id WHERE s.name='dbo' AND (t.name LIKE '%Cliente%' OR t.name LIKE '%CRM%' OR t.name LIKE '%Contacto%' OR t.name LIKE '%Usuario%') GROUP BY t.name ORDER BY identity_signal_columns DESC,t.name

queries.name: rrr_commercial_links
queries.sql: SELECT t.name AS table_name,c.name AS column_name,ty.name AS data_type FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE s.name='dbo' AND (t.name LIKE '%Venta%' OR t.name LIKE '%Ticket%' OR t.name LIKE '%Comercial%') AND (c.name LIKE '%Cliente%' OR c.name LIKE '%Unidad%' OR c.name LIKE '%Fecha%' OR c.name LIKE '%Operacion%' OR c.name LIKE '%Folio%' OR c.name LIKE '%Ticket%' OR c.name LIKE '%Total%' OR c.name LIKE '%Estado%') ORDER BY t.name,c.column_id

queries.name: rrr_engagement_structures
queries.sql: SELECT t.name AS table_name,c.name AS column_name,ty.name AS data_type FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE s.name='dbo' AND (t.name LIKE '%Notificacion%' OR t.name LIKE '%Campan%' OR t.name LIKE '%Comunic%' OR t.name LIKE '%Loyal%' OR t.name LIKE '%Reward%' OR t.name LIKE '%Punto%' OR t.name LIKE '%Saldo%' OR t.name LIKE '%Ledger%' OR t.name LIKE '%Resen%' OR t.name LIKE '%Review%' OR t.name LIKE '%NPS%' OR t.name LIKE '%Feedback%' OR t.name LIKE '%Refer%' OR t.name LIKE '%Rank%' OR t.name LIKE '%Nivel%' OR t.name LIKE '%Benef%' OR t.name LIKE '%Segment%') ORDER BY t.name,c.column_id

queries.name: rrr_cavas
queries.sql: SELECT t.name AS table_name,c.name AS column_name,ty.name AS data_type FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE s.name='dbo' AND t.name LIKE '%Cava%' ORDER BY t.name,c.column_id
